Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::createLoanTerm(itemid: Integer,content: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		lt: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = itemid and
		o.Content = content)
	precondition:
		itemid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		content.oclIsTypeOf(String)
	postcondition:
		if lt.oclIsUndefined() 
		then let newTerm: LoanTerm in
		newTerm.oclIsNew() and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(newTerm) and
		newTerm.ItemID = itemid and
		newTerm.Content = content and
		result = true 
		else result = false 
		endif 
}
